description.en: Voice-feedback plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a speak tool where the model decides what to say aloud, readReplies verbatim narration, an LLM verbalizer pass that summarizes each reply with emotional framing, per-session voice assignment, chimes, a monitoring panel, and a native macOS floating pet. zh/en i18n.
description.zh: 语音反馈插件:speak 工具(模型自主决定说什么)+ readReplies 逐字朗读 + LLM 情绪化口播(verbalizer,流式逐句)+ 按会话分配音色 + 提示音 + 监控面板 + 原生 macOS 悬浮宠物,中英双语。
